build_mlp_block: build an MLP neural network module with configurable hidden layers, batch norm, and skip connections
build_conv_block: build a convolutional neural network block with configurable kernel sizes, strides, and batch normalization
run_ensemble_forward: run forward pass on multiple models and stack their outputs as a tensor
update_target_network: soft update a target network parameters using a source network with tau interpolation factor
compute_cnn_output_dim: compute the flattened output dimension of a CNN model given input shape parameters
